signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with your passkey or get a sign-in link by email.
signIn.passkeyHint: Face ID, fingerprint, Windows Hello or your device's screen lock.
signIn.linkSent: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent you a sign-in link. It is valid for 15 minutes and can only be used once.
signIn.usePassword: Sign in with a password instead
signIn.failed: Sign-in failed. After several failed attempts, password sign-in is temporarily locked – the sign-in link by email keeps working.
signIn.passkeyFailed: Signing in with a passkey didn't work. Maybe no passkey has been set up on this device yet.
signIn.linkInvalid: The sign-in link is invalid or has expired. Please request a new one.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a moment.
signIn.inviteOnly: Access by invitation only. Please contact the people in charge at your club.

invitation.title: Welcome to the Lesson Planner
invitation.invalid: This invitation is invalid, has expired or has already been used. Please ask for a new invitation.

passkeyPrompt.title: Sign in faster with a passkey
passkeyPrompt.body: With a passkey you'll sign in using Face ID, your fingerprint or Windows Hello – no password, no waiting for an email. It's also more secure.

account.title: My account
account.passkeysIntro: Set up a passkey on every device you use (phone, tablet, computer).
account.addPasskey: Add a passkey for this device
account.passkeyAddFailed: The passkey could not be set up.
account.removePasskeyConfirm: Really remove this passkey? You won't be able to sign in with a passkey on that device anymore.
account.passwordIntro: Optional. For when neither a passkey nor email is available. At least 15 characters – a sentence of several words is ideal.
account.signOutEverywhereHint: Ends your session on all devices, including this one. Useful if you've lost a device or signed in on someone else's computer.

forgotPassword.title: Forgot password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter your email address. If an account exists, you'll receive a link to reset your password.
forgotPassword.sent: If an account exists for this address, a link is on its way. It is valid for 30 minutes.

resetPassword.title: Set a new password
resetPassword.done: Your password has been changed. All devices have been signed out.
resetPassword.invalid: The link is invalid or has expired.

password.tooShort: At least {min} characters. Tip: combine several words into a sentence.
password.common: This password is known from data breaches. Please choose another one.
password.contextual: The password is too close to your name, your email address or the club.

validation.email: Please enter a valid email address.
validation.clockTime: Please use the format HH:MM, e.g. 18:00.
validation.layoutDuplicateField: A field can only appear in one column.
